evidence.quote: Filipe Leal 7mo Report this post 2025 was a defining year for KKR in the Middle East. We opened our third regional hub in Abu Dhabi, joining our hubs in Dubai and Riyadh, appointed General David H. Petraeus, US Army (Ret.) as Chairman of KKR Middle East, established a dedicated regional investment team, and announced major partnerships including with Gulf Data Hub and ADNOC. As deal activity accelerates across the region, a recent Bloomberg article highlights both the scale of the opportunity and KKR’s ambition to meet it.
